items.quote: We hired Franklin to paint our kitchen cabinets. His pricing was refreshing, as we have done other remodels before and were prepared to get an estimate that was overwhelming. His estimate was very reasonable.
Franklin did an amazing job on the exterior of our home.

I am very impressed by the efficiency and quality of the work, they also left the house tidy and cleaned up every day, no mess. It was very easy to communicate with Franklin, he went the distance to make sure I was happy and satisfied.
